title: Technology in Counseling
tagline: The digital age is the consulting room's new neighbor.
welcome: Young people live partly online; so must your competence. This course covers telehealth, digital ethics, and the psychology of the connected child.
vignette: A teen attends telehealth from his closet, the only private place at home. The counselor notices the setting, adjusts consent and safety protocols, and the session works. Technology competence is clinical competence, extended.
vignette_attr: A telehealth session, drawn from practice
description: A course in technology and counseling: telehealth delivery and best practice, digital ethics and confidentiality online, the impact of screens and social media on development, digital assessment and tools, and reaching young people through technology responsibly.
questions: How do I hold a frame and ensure safety online?
What does the digital world do to developing minds?
How do I use tools without losing the relationship?
importance: Telehealth is now a permanent modality
Digital life is a core clinical topic with youth
Online safety and ethics are non-negotiable
misconceptions: that online counseling is second-best, when evidence supports it for many uses
that technology is the enemy, when it is a tool to be mastered
figures: who set standards for online care
whose work probes screens and cohort mental health
outcomes: You will run online sessions with frame and safety.
You will protect confidentiality and boundaries online.
You will evaluate screen and social-media impact.
You will select apps and measures with evidence.
You will coach families on healthy use.
You will use technology for engagement ethically.
modules: Online presence is a learnable craft.
The ethics code follows you online.
Assess the digital like any other domain.
tips: Establish an online emergency protocol up front
Ask about digital life in every assessment
integration: Technology competence extends every modality you have learned.
faith: We bring wisdom into the digital square, shepherding young hearts online as offline.
closing: May your online presence be as steady as your in-person one, and may the digital world be safer for your skill.
